title: Steve Ruiz - Agents on the canvas with tldraw - AI Native DevCon June 2026
description:
Can AI thrive on an infinite canvas? At tldraw, the team is pioneering real-time collaboration on the canvas with agents and users, transforming ideas into dynamic, shared experiences. Their journey hints at a future where AI truly lives on the canvas. It sounds like imagination. It's becoming reality. 

Steve Ruiz, a visionary at tldraw, has been leading this exploration with a focus on real-time drawing interfaces, automated workflows, and spatialized on-canvas agents. Through projects like makereal.tldraw.com and fairies.tldraw.com, Steve is redefining how AI and humans interact on digital surfaces.

What we cover:
• The evolution of AI collaboration on tldraw’s infinite canvas
• How 'vibe coding' reached escape velocity in 2023
• What makes realtime drawing interfaces successful?
• AI workflows and spatialized agents with fairies.tldraw.com
• The future potential for AI on digital canvases
